title: They always live in Canada.

author: Pixar
description:
'Win or Lose' Writer & Director Carrie Hobson and Michael Yates, along with Producer David Lally, break down Van's worst nightmare: a HIGH SCHOOL HOUSE PARTY. They discuss how the scene came together from storyboards to final frame and the lengths Vanessa will go to find her daughter, Rochelle.
